get_config_li_wqmc: get the FermiNet configuration for running lithium atom simulations with weighted QMC optimization
adjust_nuclear_charge: adjust the nuclear charge and electron count for a single atom in a FermiNet config
run_li_wqmc_simulation: run a weighted QMC simulation for a lithium atom using the psiformer network
configure_spin_polarisation: configure spin polarisation for a lithium atom in the FermiNet wqmc config
set_kfac_norm_constraint: set the KFAC norm constraint to 1e-3 for lithium wqmc optimization
